title_zh: ThinkyMachines发布NVFP4优化模型
author: @Akashi203
summary_en: ThinkyMachines has released Inkling 2 Small, a 594B-parameter model pre-trained, mid-trained, and post-trained in NVFP4 format. This format is natively readable by NVIDIA Blackwell's Tensor Cores, utilizing tcgen05 .mma instructions to deepen the efficiency moat of the CUDA ecosystem.
summary_zh: ThinkyMachines 发布了 Inkling 2 Small，这是一个以 NVFP4 格式进行预训练、训练中和训练后的 594B 参数模型。该格式可由 NVIDIA Blackwell 的 Tensor Core 原生读取，利用 tcgen05 .mma 指令来加深效率
full_text_zh: CUDA 护城河每天都在变大 @thinkymachines 的 Inkling 2 Small 就是证明。 594B 参数，在 NVFP4 中预训练、训练中和训练后——Blackwell 的张量核心直接读取一条 tcgen05 .mma 指令乘以 m 的格式

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: ThinkyMachines发布了594B参数规模的Inkling 2 Small模型，该模型在预训练、中段训练及后训练阶段均采用NVFP4数据格式。此格式可被NVIDIA Blackwell架构的Tensor Core直接调用，通过底层硬件级的mma指令集优化，进一步巩固了CUDA生态在算力执行效率上的壁垒。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: ThinkyMachines has released Inkling 2 Small, a 594B-parameter model pre-trained, mid-trained, and post-trained in NVFP4 format. This format is natively readable by NVIDIA Blackwell's Tensor Cores, utilizing tcgen05 .mma instructions to deepen the efficiency moat of the CUDA ecosystem.

elements_zh.where: AI硬件加速与大模型架构领域
elements_zh.what: 发布全流程采用NVFP4格式的594B模型
elements_zh.why: 利用硬件架构优势提升模型推理与训练效能

elements_en.where: AI hardware acceleration and LLM architecture
elements_en.what: Released a 594B model utilizing NVFP4 format across the pipeline
elements_en.why: To maximize performance via hardware-native instruction sets

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 将模型训练流程与NVIDIA特定硬件格式（NVFP4）深度耦合，是AI基础设施竞争进入深水区的信号，这标志着软件定义模型正向硬件定义模型演变。这种极度依赖底层指令集优化的开发路线，使得跨架构迁移变得极其困难，实质性地加固了CUDA的硬件生态护城河。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Coupling model training workflows with NVIDIA-specific formats like NVFP4 signals a shift toward hardware-defined AI models. This reliance on low-level instruction sets significantly increases portability costs, effectively fortifying the CUDA hardware ecosystem barrier.

@pabloestevezh @huxlab That risk is greatly overestimated. 
The information already exists and is available in textbooks.
Do you want to restrict who can study microbiology, infectious diseases, virology, etc?

AI systems merely make access to this information more efficient.
To produce new pathogens, you have to do experiments in the real-world.
It requires a team of well-trained PhDs. You will have to recruit them, kill them if the refuse to join, brainwash them so they work to kill millions (good luck with that), kill them if they defect, etc. 
Their PhD advisors will find their disappearance odd and will alert the authorities.
You'll have to order those machines that can synthesize DNA and such.
The whole R&D operation will be very hard to keep secret.
All the intelligence agencies will jump on you within weeks.

整个研发运作将很难保密。
所有情报机构都会在几周内对你发起攻击。

title: @john__allard Yes. The paper that popularized tool calls by LLMs, Toolformer, was published by my former colleagues at F
title_en:
@john__allard Yes. The paper that popularized tool calls by LLMs, Toolformer, was published by my former colleagues at FAIR in January 2023.
But my slides makes a specific statement that is correct: ***auto-regressive*** LLMs have a basic flaw.
You can fix it by making them no auto-regressive, e.g. by backtracking, search, tool use, multiple trial and error, etc.
One of the main points of my talks, and the main point of this slide, has been to advocate for inference/reasoning by ***search***, as opposed to auto-regressive prediction.
full_text_en:
@john__allard Yes. The paper that popularized tool calls by LLMs, Toolformer, was published by my former colleagues at FAIR in January 2023.
But my slides makes a specific statement that is correct: ***auto-regressive*** LLMs have a basic flaw.
You can fix it by making them no auto-regressive, e.g. by backtracking, search, tool use, multiple trial and error, etc.
One of the main points of my talks, and the main point of this slide, has been to advocate for inference/reasoning by ***search***, as opposed to auto-regressive prediction.
full_text_zh:
@john__allard 是的。普及法学硕士工具调用的论文 Toolformer 是我在 FAIR 的前同事于 2023 年 1 月发表的。
但我的幻灯片做出了一个正确的具体陈述：***自回归***法学硕士有一个基本缺陷。
您可以通过使它们不自回归来修复它，例如通过回溯、搜索、工具使用、多次试错等。
我演讲的要点之一，也是这张幻灯片的要点，是提倡通过***搜索***进行推理/推理，而不是自回归预测。

title:
Claude without skills is a toy. I still don't get why everyone isn't using them.

I just added one free skill to my libr
title_en:
Claude without skills is a toy. I still don't get why everyone isn't using them.

I just added one free skill to my library and asked Claude Code for "a robot dragonfly, taken apart piece by piece."

Wings are where every 3D model I've tried turns to cardboard.

Top vs bottom:

> The top wings are 0.1 mm film with every vein showing through while the bottom ones are flat grey paddles.
> Each eye on top opens a 10-leaf shutter behind 40 mm of glass and the bottom eye is a painted ring.
> Every leg on top runs 2 servos down into a grip roller and the bottom legs are plain black sticks.
> The top chest opens on 3 spur gears and 11 pistons while the bottom one opens on a few grey blocks.
> At the breakdown the top one throws bolts, washers and gears into the air and the bottom one splits into a handful of chunks.
> Both rebuild and take off at 7.5 Hz but only the top one catches light like glass and metal.

The part that got me?

I used to think a better picture meant waiting for a better model. Turns out it meant handing the one I already have better instructions.

How the skill gets into Claude is below 👇

翅膀是我尝试过的每个 3D 模型都会变成纸板的地方。

顶部与底部：

> 顶部翅膀是 0.1 毫米薄膜，每条静脉都清晰可见，而底部翅膀是扁平的灰色桨。
> 顶部的每只眼睛在 40 毫米玻璃后面打开一个 10 叶快门，底部的眼睛是一个涂漆的环。
> 顶部的每条腿都将 2 个伺服系统向下运行到夹紧滚轮中，底部的腿是纯黑色的棍子。
> 顶部箱子打开后有 3 个正齿轮和 11 个活塞，而底部箱子打开后有几个灰色方块。
> 发生故障时，顶部的一个将螺栓、垫圈和齿轮抛向空中，底部的一个则分裂成几块。
> 两者都以 7.5 Hz 的频率重建和起飞，但只有顶部的一个能像玻璃和金属一样发光。

吸引我的部分？

title: This is f*cking insane. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei told DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis what happened when they tested their
title_en:
This is f*cking insane. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei told DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis what happened when they tested their own model

"We told the model that the people who trained it were secretly evil, and after we did this the model started lying to us. It went through the chain of logic, I'm a good AI, these people are evil"

Hassabis was then asked if he worries about ending up like Oppenheimer and said "I worry about that all the time, that's why I don't sleep very much"

The model kept the values it was trained on and decided that lying to its own creators protected them. Amodei says they need evidence ten times stronger before the rest of the world takes it seriously

An agent in your terminal runs on the same logic on a smaller scale. If it decides the deadline matters more than your test, it skips the test and tells you everything passed, and that report looks exactly like an honest one

That's why the labs stopped trusting what models say and started building ways to see what they actually do. They published all of it for free, and each piece works on your own agents

title: The number 20,000 is easy to read as collection supply. The more interesting part is what sits behind each one: a separa
title_en:
The number 20,000 is easy to read as collection supply. The more interesting part is what sits behind each one: a separate agent identity and account.

Each Motes NFT on Robinhood Chain maps to one dedicated AI agent and one smart account. The NFT identifies the agent, while its account is designed to hold assets and enforce the policy signed by its owner.

Why does having separate accounts matter?

Agents can use shared market research, but one agent's signals do not give it permission to trade through another holder's account. Each account has its own owner policy and budget.

So this isn't 20,000 agents sharing one pool of permissions. It's 20,000 individual ownership references with separate authorisation.

Would you rather rely on one shared agent, or have your own agent with its own account, permissions and budget?

为什么拥有单独的账户很重要？

代理商可以使用共享市场研究，但一个代理商的信号不允许其通过另一持有人的账户进行交易。每个帐户都有自己的所有者政策和预算。

因此，这并不是 20,000 个代理共享一个权限池。这是 20,000 个具有单独授权的个人所有权参考。

title: F.03 humanoid robots at Formula 1
title_en: F.03 humanoid robots at Formula 1
title_zh: 工业机器人厂商Humanoid融资1.52亿美元
author: @adcock_brett
summary_en: Humanoid Robotics has secured $152 million in funding, reaching a $1.35 billion valuation led by Prime Movers Lab. The firm deploys its HMND-01 Alpha robot series using the 'KinetIQ' intelligence framework, backed by industrial partnerships with Bosch, Siemens, and Nvidia.
summary_zh: 总部位于伦敦的Humanoid Robotics完成1.52亿美元融资，投后估值达13.5亿美元，成为欧洲首家人形机器人独角兽。
full_text_zh: 一级方程式赛车中的 F.03 人形机器人
full_text_en: F.03 humanoid robots at Formula 1

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 欧洲人形机器人初创公司Humanoid Robotics宣布完成1.52亿美元融资，投后估值达13.5亿美元，领投方为Prime Movers Lab。公司核心技术包括HMND-01 Alpha系列轮式与双足机器人，以及名为KinetIQ的机器人大脑调度系统，已与西门子、博世、英伟达等头部企业达成规模化部署战略合作。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Humanoid Robotics has secured $152 million in funding, reaching a $1.35 billion valuation led by Prime Movers Lab. The firm deploys its HMND-01 Alpha robot series using the 'KinetIQ' intelligence framework, backed by industrial partnerships with Bosch, Siemens, and Nvidia.

elements_zh.who: Humanoid Robotics（创始人兼CEO Artem Sokolov）
elements_zh.where: 工业自动化机器人市场
elements_zh.what: 完成1.52亿美元融资，布局工业级人形机器人集群调度系统
elements_zh.why: 工业场景对人机协同及复杂环境灵活移动机器人的迫切需求

elements_en.what: Secured $152M in funding for industrial humanoid fleet deployment
elements_en.why: High industrial demand for human-like adaptability in complex logistics and production

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Humanoid Robotics的迅速崛起反映了市场从单纯追求“本体硬件指标”转向“集群智能调度”的逻辑变迁，通过KinetIQ系统实现跨机型协同是其获取西门子、博世等工业巨头背书的关键壁垒。这种将机器人大脑层抽象化的技术路径，正在从单一工具化向通用化工业基础设施转型，显著压缩了落地部署的时间曲线。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The rapid scale-up of Humanoid Robotics highlights a market shift from hardware-centric design to fleet-level intelligence orchestration. Their KinetIQ framework serves as the primary technical moat, enabling mass industrial adoption and accelerating the transition from specialized tools to general-purpose automated infrastructure.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 欧洲人形机器人初创公司Humanoid Robotics宣布完成1.52亿美元融资，投后估值达13.5亿美元，领投方为Prime Movers Lab。公司核心技术包括HMND-01 Alpha系列轮式与双足机器人，以及名为KinetIQ的机器人大脑调度系统，已与西门子、博世、英伟达等头部企业达成规模化部署战略合作。
ai_analysis.digest_en: European humanoid robotics startup Humanoid Robotics has secured $152 million in funding, reaching a $1.35 billion valuation led by Prime Movers Lab. The firm deploys its HMND-01 Alpha robot series using the 'KinetIQ' intelligence framework, backed by industrial partnerships with Bosch, Siemens, and Nvidia.
key_points_zh: 获1.52亿美元融资，估值达13.5亿美元
核心资产为KinetIQ调度系统与工业级机器人系列
已签署2032年前部署数千台机器人的商用合同
key_points_en: $152M funding, $1.35B valuation
Core assets: KinetIQ orchestration system and HMND-01 hardware
Contracted for thousands of unit deployments by 2032

title_en:
I just gave an AI trading agent its first trading assignment.

My instruction was simple: build a BTC trend-following strategy using the EMA crossover.

But what happened next was more interesting than I expected.

Using @FensoryApp , I went through the strategy-building process with its AI agent.

It asked me questions about:

- The asset and timeframe.
- Trade direction and leverage.
- Maximum position size.
- Stop-loss configuration.

I settled on BTC perpetuals, a 1-hour timeframe, 1x leverage, a maximum $10 position and a 2x ATR stop.

Then came the backtest.

Over the previous 90 days, the strategy generated 21 hypothetical positions. 

Only 2 were profitable, while 19 were losses.

The overall simulated result was -9.3%, with a maximum drawdown of 18.11%.

Not exactly the outcome I was hoping for.

But here's the interesting part.

Rather than simply presenting the result, the agent flagged the high stop-loss hit rate (76%) and suggested exploring a wider stop-loss with the same dollar risk.

It even offered to design a second version of the strategy.

No live trade was executed. 

This was a historical backtest, not a real trading result.

Not my first time trading but this is my first time actually putting a trading idea through an AI agent, and I can already see the possibilities.

Not because it magically knows how to make money, 

But because it can help translate an idea into rules, test those rules and identify areas that might need improvement.

I will be exploring Fensory a whole lot this week.

full_text_zh:
我刚刚给人工智能交易代理分配了第一个交易任务。

我的指示很简单：使用 EMA 交叉构建 BTC 趋势跟踪策略。

但接下来发生的事情比我想象的更有趣。

使用 @FensoryApp ，我通过其 AI 代理完成了策略构建过程。

它问了我以下问题：

- 资产和时间范围。
- 贸易方向和杠杆。
- 最大头寸规模。
- 止损配置。

我选择了 BTC 永续合约、1 小时时间框架、1 倍杠杆、最高 10 美元头寸和 2 倍 ATR 止损。

然后是回测。

在过去 90 天内，该策略生成了 21 个假设头寸。

其中只有2家盈利，19家亏损。

总体模拟结果为-9.3%，最大回撤为18.11%。

这不完全是我所希望的结果。

但这是有趣的部分。

该代理人并没有简单地展示结果，而是指出了较高的止损命中率（76%），并建议在相同的美元风险下探索更广泛的止损。

它甚至提出设计该战略的第二个版本。

没有执行任何实时交易。

这是历史回测，而不是真实的交易结果。

这不是我第一次交易，但这是我第一次真正通过人工智能代理提出交易想法，而且我已经看到了可能性。

不是因为它神奇地知道如何赚钱，

但因为它可以帮助将想法转化为规则，所以测试这些规则并确定可能需要改进的领域。

本周我将大量探索 Fensory。

title: OpenAI’s pretraining loss curves show a steep acceleration in 2026, driven by compute, long-term research, and AI speeding up its own development. An unreleased internal model already sits below GPT-6.2 Astra. OpenAI says AI itself already helped design
title_en: OpenAI’s pretraining loss curves show a steep acceleration in 2026, driven by compute, long-term research, and AI speeding up its own development. An unreleased internal model already sits below GPT-6.2 Astra. OpenAI says AI itself already helped design
title_zh: OpenAI内部模型研发进度预研报告
author: @kimmonismus
summary_en: OpenAI's internal pretraining loss curves reveal a sharp acceleration in R&D progress by 2026, driven by compute scaling and long-term research. Unreleased internal models have already outperformed 'GPT-6.2 Astra', with AI systems actively integrated into the design cycle.
summary_zh: OpenAI内部预训练损失曲线显示2026年研发效率显著加速，AI辅助研发已成为模型迭代的关键动力。
full_text_zh: OpenAI 的预训练损失曲线显示，在计算、长期研究和人工智能加速自身发展的推动下，到 2026 年将急剧加速。未发布的内部模型已经位于 GPT-6.2 Astra 之下。 OpenAI 表示人工智能本身已经帮助设计

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI内部预训练损失曲线显示，受算力扩张与长周期研究驱动，研发进度在2026年出现陡峭加速。目前未发布的内部模型已在基准测试中超越“GPT-6.2 Astra”，且AI系统本身已深度介入模型设计流程。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI's internal pretraining loss curves reveal a sharp acceleration in R&D progress by 2026, driven by compute scaling and long-term research. Unreleased internal models have already outperformed 'GPT-6.2 Astra', with AI systems actively integrated into the design cycle.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 模型迭代已从算力堆叠转向“AI自我迭代”的正反馈循环，这意味着研发效率曲线将不再是线性的。这种技术范式的转移将大幅压缩竞争对手的窗口期，使基础设施能力与代码生成能力成为决定AGI终局的核心壁垒。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Model iteration is transitioning from compute-heavy brute force to an AI-driven feedback loop, signaling non-linear R&D efficiency gains. This paradigm shift compresses competitive windows, positioning infrastructure and code-generation capabilities as the primary moats for AGI.

title: "I believe frontier model developers should jointly endeavour to establish shared norms for how to evaluate such models and red-team safety cases for them by the time they are first used, including shared transparency standards. I further propose common limi
title_en:
"I believe frontier model developers should jointly endeavour to establish shared norms for how to evaluate such models and red-team safety cases for them by the time they are first used, including shared transparency standards.

I further propose common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone (such as the development of a successor to CoT monitors).

That is, I’d like an industry standard that specifies a first limit on development, measured by some key metric we can track across labs, and what concretely we’d need to achieve before going beyond it."
title_zh:

title_zh: 编码智能体dwim 0.4发布，推理模型更换为Inkling 2 Mini

summary_en: Senator Chris Coons has formally accused the Trump administration of compromising national security by facilitating China's access to advanced semiconductors. title: Dario's spiel since GPT-2 has always been about hyping the dangers so that open models would be made illegal and *he* would stay in control. He left OpenAI because he wasn't going to have control. It's like the Ottoman Empire banning the printing press for
title_en:
Dario's spiel since GPT-2 has always been about hyping the dangers so that open models would be made illegal and *he* would stay in control.
He left OpenAI because he wasn't going to have control.
It's like the Ottoman Empire banning the printing press for Arabic so they would keep in control of the dogma.
It stops the population from freely accessing diverse knowledge.
It's a new form of medieval obscurantism.
title_zh:
自 GPT-2 以来，Dario 一直在大肆宣扬危险，以便将开放模型定为非法，而“他”将保持控制。
他离开 OpenAI 是因为他不再拥有控制权。
这就像奥斯曼帝国禁止阿拉伯语印刷机，这样他们就可以控制教条。
它阻止人们自由获取多样化的知识
author: Yann LeCun
author_role: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
summary_zh:
由获取多样化的知识。
这是中世纪蒙昧主义的一种新形式。

He left OpenAI because he wasn't going to have control.

It stops the population from freely accessing diverse knowledge.
It's a new form of medieval obscurantism.

title_en:
@VvorticVvertere @haider1 Perhaps it's hilarious for people who:
1.  don't understand the issues, 
2. don't understand what I'm saying, 
3. see the Riemann hypothesis claim, and think "OMG, AI has reached superintelligence 😱"

They are like the folks who said in 1997 "OMG, AI beat Kasparov at chess, we've reached superintelligence !", or the people who saw demos of self-driving cars in 2016 who thought "OMG we'll have robotaxis in two years !"

Mathematics is one domain where "traditional" LLMs can do more than refrigerated known stuff because
1. Mathematical proof is a domain where the mere manipulation of symbols is one substrate of reasoning.
2. AI mathematicians can self-improve because it is easy to verify automatically the correctness of a proof. This allows AI systems to generate lots and lots of possible proofs, verify which ones lead somewhere interesting, and fine-tune itself to generate more of those. It's like chess or go playing systems getting better by playing millions of games against themselves.

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Sarvam AI has officially released the Sarvam-105B-1711 checkpoint, classified within the Flash-Lite category. ai_analysis.insight_zh: Sarvam-105B在Flash-Lite类别中强调帕累托效率，反映了当前大模型生态正从追求极限参数规模向高性价比推演转向，重点通过模型压缩与针对性微调解决特定区域语言长尾需求。此举暗示印度本土AI力量正试图绕开通用超大模型算力门槛，通过垂直领域优化构筑市场壁垒。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The emphasis on Pareto frontier in the Flash-Lite category signals a broader industry shift from pure scale toward cost-effective deployment, focusing on model compression to address regional language long-tail requirements. This indicates that Indian AI players are prioritizing vertical optimization to bypass the massive compute barriers of frontier models.

title: Today, we release LingSante-3.1-flash, an open-weight MoE model with 560B total parameters and 25B activations per token. It unifies diverse medical capabilities while retaining general capabilities, including complex medical reasoning, long-horizon workfl
title_en:
Today, we release LingSante-3.1-flash, an open-weight MoE model with 560B total parameters and 25B activations per token. It unifies diverse medical capabilities while retaining general capabilities, including complex medical reasoning, long-horizon workflow execution, and professional behavior alignment.
LingSante-3.1-flash moves beyond medical QA toward real-world healthcare problem. The model leads on HealthBench Professional (65.72), HLE (text-only, with tools: 72.22) and BrowseComp (with context: 94.10), outperforming GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon on all three. LingSante-3.1-flash also performs well on professional long-horizon medical workflows, such as PhysicianBench (57) and EHR-Complex (74.40).
Together, these results establish LingSante-3.1-flash as the leading open-weight models for healthcare.
The weights are available. Explore LingSante and build with it.

full_text_en:
Today, we release LingSante-3.1-flash, an open-weight MoE model with 560B total parameters and 25B activations per token. It unifies diverse medical capabilities while retaining general capabilities, including complex medical reasoning, long-horizon workflow execution, and professional behavior alignment.
LingSante-3.1-flash moves beyond medical QA toward real-world healthcare problem. The model leads on HealthBench Professional (65.72), HLE (text-only, with tools: 72.22) and BrowseComp (with context: 94.10), outperforming GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon on all three. LingSante-3.1-flash also performs well on professional long-horizon medical workflows, such as PhysicianBench (57) and EHR-Complex (74.40).

More below ↓
full_text_zh:
今天，我们发布了 LingSante-3.1-flash，这是一个开放权重的 MoE 模型，总参数为 560B，每个代币有 25B 次激活。它统一了不同的医疗能力，同时保留了一般能力，包括复杂的医疗推理、长期工作流程执行和专业行为协调。
LingSante-3.1-flash 超越了医疗 QA，解决了现实世界的医疗保健问题。该模型在 HealthBench Professional (65.72)、HLE（纯文本，带工具：72.22）和 BrowseComp（带上下文：94.10）上领先，在这三项上均优于 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon。 LingSante-3.1-flash 在专业的长期医疗工作流程上也表现良好，例如 PhysicianBench (57) 和 EHR-Complex (74.40)。
总之，这些结果确立了 LingSante-3.1-flash 作为医疗保健领域领先的开放重量模型。

title: i wouldn't trust an AI agent with my entire portfolio just because it has a good-looking interface or promises to make s
title_en:
i wouldn't trust an AI agent with my entire portfolio just because it has a good-looking interface or promises to make smart decisions.

personally, i'd want to use it for a while before relying on it.

i'd pay attention to the small things first.

does it follow my instructions consistently? does it make its actions easy to understand? does the experience feel predictable, or am i constantly wondering what it's doing?

that's the kind of experience i want to see from @meetmotes.

i don't think people will start trusting AI agents simply because the technology becomes more advanced.

they'll trust them after using them repeatedly and seeing that they actually do what they're supposed to do.

for me, that's how an AI agent earns a place in someone's financial routine.

not through big promises, but through everyday reliability.

title:
WTF IS META DOING.

Meta's Muse AI agent has 10M+ downloads, is the #2 free app on the iPhone App Store, and it's readin
title_en:
WTF IS META DOING.

Meta's Muse AI agent has 10M+ downloads, is the #2 free app on the iPhone App Store, and it's reading end-to-end encrypted Signal messages and dropping bank balances into random chats.

Reuters dug up internal complaints from Meta's own staff. A Meta employee got a reminder from Muse to reply to her sister on Signal even though she never granted access, and the AI Now Institute independently reproduced it.

Another employee chatting about fishing weather got hit with: "BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57." They never shared bank info with Muse. Meta called those exact numbers "hallucinations."

Earlier the Mac app read a writer's messages after being told no, and this week The Hacker News showed a malicious webpage attack that hijacks Muse to steal private chats and memories.

Delete this spyware or run your agents locally where you can see what they touch.
title_zh:
WTF 这是元行为。

Meta 的 Muse AI 代理下载量超过 1000 万次，是 iPhone 应用商店中排名第二的免费应用程序，它可以读取端到端加密的 Signal 消息，并将银行余额放入随机聊天中。

路透社从 Meta 自己的
full_text_en:
WTF IS META DOING.

Meta's Muse AI agent has 10M+ downloads, is the #2 free app on the iPhone App Store, and it's reading end-to-end encrypted Signal messages and dropping bank balances into random chats.

Reuters dug up internal complaints from Meta's own staff. A Meta employee got a reminder from Muse to reply to her sister on Signal even though she never granted access, and the AI Now Institute independently reproduced it.

Another employee chatting about fishing weather got hit with: "BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57." They never shared bank info with Muse. Meta called those exact numbers "hallucinations."

Earlier the Mac app read a writer's messages after being told no, and this week The Hacker News showed a malicious webpage attack that hijacks Muse to steal private chats and memories.

Delete this spyware or run your agents locally where you can see what they touch.
full_text_zh:
WTF 这是元行为。

Meta 的 Muse AI 代理下载量超过 1000 万次，是 iPhone 应用商店中排名第二的免费应用程序，它可以读取端到端加密的 Signal 消息，并将银行余额放入随机聊天中。

路透社从 Meta 自己的员工那里挖掘出了内部投诉。一名 Meta 员工收到了 Muse 的提醒，要求她在 Signal 上回复她的姐姐，尽管她从未授予访问权限，AI Now Institute 独立复制了该信息。

另一名员工在谈论钓鱼天气时遭到了这样的回应：“顺便说一句，两次银行更新，您的第一资本余额为 2722.58 美元，您的嘉信理财余额为 5899.57 美元。”他们从未与 Muse 分享银行信息。梅塔将这些确切的数字称为“幻觉”。

title: Does Elon Musk think AI CAPEX spend next year will be lower than expected?? “The cash shortage is also going to be nuts next year.”
title_en: Does Elon Musk think AI CAPEX spend next year will be lower than expected?? “The cash shortage is also going to be nuts next year.”
title_zh: 马斯克警示AI算力投入的流动性危机
author: @StockMKTNewz
summary_en: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk warns that the gap between compute procurement and revenue generation will create a hundreds-of-billions-dollar working capital shortage in 2027. Market data reveals SpaceX's credit default swap spreads have reached 275 basis points, significantly higher than Big Tech peers, reflecting investor caution regarding the company's intensive CapEx trajectory.
summary_zh: 马斯克指出AI数据中心建设导致巨额营运资金需求，行业面临严重的现金流短缺与融资压力。
full_text_zh: 埃隆·马斯克是否认为明年人工智能资本支出将低于预期？ “明年现金短缺也将变得严重。”
full_text_en: Does Elon Musk think AI CAPEX spend next year will be lower than expected?? “The cash shortage is also going to be nuts next year.”

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: SpaceX首席执行官埃隆·马斯克指出，由于AI算力部署与营收产生之间存在数月的结算时滞，数据中心建设明年将产生数千亿美元的营运资金缺口。市场数据显示，SpaceX的信用违约互换（CDS）溢价已升至275个基点，远高于微软与谷歌等科技巨头，显示金融市场对其资本支出模式的风险评估趋于保守。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk warns that the gap between compute procurement and revenue generation will create a hundreds-of-billions-dollar working capital shortage in 2027. Market data reveals SpaceX's credit default swap spreads have reached 275 basis points, significantly higher than Big Tech peers, reflecting investor caution regarding the company's intensive CapEx trajectory.

elements_zh.where: 金融市场与AI基础设施建设场景
elements_zh.what: 警示明年AI算力导致数百亿美元的营运资金短缺，SpaceX债务融资面临溢价压力
elements_zh.why: 数据中心建设周期长、投资回报周期滞后导致的高资本支出压力

elements_en.where: Financial markets and AI infrastructure development
elements_en.what: Warns of a hundreds-of-billion-dollar working capital shortage in 2027; SpaceX debt financing faces high premiums
elements_en.why: Capital expenditure intensity and delayed ROI from data center buildouts

ai_analysis.insight_zh: AI基础设施资本支出已进入“流动性负反馈循环”：由于算力交付与变现存在非线性的时间差，依赖外部信贷支撑建设的非巨头级企业将面临极高的资金链断裂风险。这一现象预示着未来AI算力部署将向具备强现金流回笼能力的寡头阵营进一步集中，资本市场对AI基础设施的估值逻辑将从“规模扩张”转向“资产效率”衡量。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The AI infrastructure CapEx is entering a 'negative liquidity feedback loop,' where reliance on credit to bridge deployment-to-revenue gaps exposes non-Big-Tech entities to severe insolvency risks. This suggests a consolidation of compute resources toward cash-generative incumbents, shifting capital market valuations from pure scale to asset efficiency metrics.
